[hook] Why your Claude Code cards all look identical.
[stake] Send clients the preview link and they'll know Claude Code built it.
[comparison] Same rounded cards. Same rgba(0,0,0,.1) shadow. One radius.
[comparison] Headlines: one accented word, all-caps labels, an arrow on buttons.
[proof] Anthropic flags them all in SKILL.md, updated September 2026.
[comparison] It also warns against cream with terracotta, #D97757, Anthropic's own accent.
[mechanism] Unguided, models converge. Anthropic calls it distributional convergence.
[mechanism] It makes Claude plan first, review for anything generic, then code.
[step] Fix it. Run /plugin install frontend-design@claude-plugins-official.
[payoff] Pick a scope, and it runs by itself on every frontend request.
[ask] Comment TELLS now. I'll send the checklist before another identical launch.

[proof] Anthropic verified. 1,134,112 installs as of November 2026.

[payoff] Then it turns on by itself when you ask for frontend work.
